visualCharacteristics.structure: tags + heading + text + label + CTA | image

contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells (either order): text cell = tags (a bulleted list, or one paragraph of comma-separated tags, placed before the heading), h3, paragraph(s), italic-only read-time paragraph (e.g. '*5 min read*'), CTA link (bold = primary button) | image cell = image only. Section heading ('Take a deeper look.') is default content above the block. Mobile shows the image above the text.
